title: Measurement-aware identification of 48-hour acute kidney injury persistence
description: Reproducible phenotype specification, database mappings, statistical scripts, synthetic tests, and non-disclosive aggregate results for interval-defined 48-hour persistence of creatinine-defined acute kidney injury across MIMIC-IV v3.1, SICdb v1.0.8, and eICU-CRD v2.0. Version 1.1.0 corrects unique-patient clustering, uses hospital-to-patient two-stage bootstrap resampling for eICU, removes obsolete mortality, inverse-observation-weighting, and hospital-ranking modules from the submission freeze, and adds core robustness and observation-process outputs.
